question: How can you solve an equation one prime-power digit at a time?
answer: Each new digit only has to work for one more power of 3, so there are just three choices (0, 1 or 2) to test, and exactly one fits. Repeating this step forever makes the digits build an exact 3-adic solution of x² = 7. The slider lets you add one digit at a time, up to 9 digits.
move: Solve modulo 3, then 9, then 27… each step adds one digit of the answer.

web.label: Interactive page with a slider from 0 to 9 digits. Each step tries 0, 1 or 2 for the next power of 3, building the digits of a solution to x² = 7 one at a time.

source: Veritasium, “What happens if you just keep squaring?” (YouTube, 2023)
